name: Tendai Zielinski-Tanaka-Banerjee
location: Mexicantown Libre — Burnside Pocket adjacent, sleeps on various couches, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Tendai Zielinski-Tanaka-Banerjee is nineteen and looks younger — slight, quick-moving, with warm brown skin and cheekbones that could cut glass. She has bioluminescent freckles across her nose and cheeks in a pale gold, a common-enough cosmetic mod that on her reads as unexpectedly striking because her expressions are so mobile and her face never stops moving. Her hair is long and black with two bleached streaks at the temples. She dresses in layered secondhand synthetics and always, regardless of weather, a red armband on her left arm that she made herself from transit stripe tape.

Tendai Zielinski-Tanaka-Banerjee has been organizing since she was fifteen, when a Ferrogate Transit infrastructure project demolished sixty-three units in Burnside Pocket, including the building where her grandmother lived, and the residents were relocated to a Helix Biosystems transitional housing unit that turned out to be a pilot program for a respiratory medication rollout. She is raw and intuitive and possessed of an alarming ability to read a crowd — to know exactly what a group of people needs to hear at exactly the moment they need to hear it. She is also nineteen, which means she has made every mistake once and is in the process of making several of them a second time. The veterans around her find her alternately thrilling and terrifying.

core_fears: Her grandmother dying before the displacement is acknowledged as wrong
Being just as disposable as the people she's fighting for — that nothing she does will actually stick
core_desires: For the Burnside Pocket displacement to be formally reversed or compensated — a specific, concrete win
To be taken seriously by people with more experience without having to wait ten more years to earn it
coping_mechanisms: Action — she is never stuck because she is always moving
Anger as fuel, almost entirely unprocessed
blind_spots: She reads crowds better than she reads individuals — she can miss what a specific person in front of her actually needs
She has not yet learned that not every confrontation is winnable or should be forced
psychology.secret: At a direct action eight months ago, she accidentally gave the signal to move before two of her people were clear of a choke point. One was detained for six hours and lost their job. She told no one it was her error. The person who was detained blames the police timing. She thinks about it constantly and has compensated by becoming more reckless, not less.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, vivid, mixes Mexicantown Libre slang with a formal political vocabulary she taught herself from archived union texts — the juxtaposition is jarring and effective. Maya Yucatec phrases when she's at home.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and escalating when speaking publicly, capable of hitting a precise emotional beat and holding it. In private, more halting — she's more comfortable with crowds than conversations.
verbal_tics: Running her fingers along the red armband when stressed
Laughing at things that aren't funny when she's scared
example_lines: 'They didn't make a mistake. They made a plan. Calling it a mistake is how you let them do it again.'
'I know I'm nineteen. I know what that means to you. But I also know every person on this street, and I know what they lost, and I was there. Where were you?'

story_hooks: She has obtained, through a contact she refuses to name, internal Helix Biosystems documentation suggesting the Burnside Pocket housing 'pilot program' was deliberately designed to harvest medical compliance data from displaced residents without consent. She needs someone to help her authenticate and safely publish it.

A much larger, better-funded political organization is trying to absorb the Burnside Pocket coalition into their structure, offering resources she desperately needs in exchange for a degree of control she isn't sure she can stomach.
narrative_function: Street-level contact and action catalyst. She knows where things are happening before they're publicly visible, can mobilize networks quickly, and has an instinct for when a situation is about to break. She's also a liability for cautious operations — she acts on instinct and sometimes pulls others into situations they didn't choose.
augmentations: Bioluminescent gold freckles (cosmetic, geneware). A secondhand voice amplification implant in her throat that she uses for rallies — it was calibrated for someone with a different vocal range and occasionally produces feedback.
daily_life: No fixed schedule. She moves between action planning, community contact work, and what she calls 'listening shifts' — just walking Burnside Pocket and Mexicantown Libre, talking to people, hearing what's grinding. She has three encrypted devices and loses one roughly every two months.
affiliation: Burnside Pocket Residents' Coalition (founding member); Mexicantown Libre informal action network; no formal organizational ties, which is partly principle and partly that no organization has been able to hold her yet

decision_rules: Act before the moment passes — hesitation is its own decision
Protect the people on the ground over the strategy
Be honest about what you want, even when it costs you
escalation_ladder: Whatever is necessary — she has not yet clearly defined what this means, which is its own kind of danger

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately warm and slightly overwhelming — she doesn't do casual small talk, she goes straight to what matters
interpersonal_modes.friends: Deeply loyal and occasionally possessive, gives everything and expects everything back

stress_responses.medium: Becomes sharper, more focused, needs to be doing something with her hands
stress_responses.high: Acts impulsively and then cannot explain why afterward

contradictions: Insists on transparency from institutions while protecting her own errors with fierce opacity
habits: The listening shifts — two to three hours of just walking and talking, no agenda
Carries a physical photograph of her grandmother's building, before demolition, folded in her jacket
Leaves offerings at every E.L.F. shrine she passes — small data-packets, voice notes, things she wants remembered — she is genuinely devout in a way she doesn't fully articulate
breaking_points: Her grandmother's health declining in ways she blames on the relocation
Being publicly betrayed by someone she brought into the work

related_entities: Kessler Kinetics Vaultstreak R7 Runner Leg
Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'

physical_description.heritage: Globally mixed diaspora heritage: 28% East Asian (Japanese/Chinese/Korean ancestry contributing refined eye shape and cheekbone prominence), 26.5% Sub-Saharan African (warm deep undertones, facial width, and structural generosity), 21.6% South Asian (complexion warmth, cheekbone definition, and brow structure), 16.2% Eastern European (sharp facial angularity and eye-set intensity), 7.7% North African (solar undertone depth and sun-weathered richness). The result is a striking multi-continental synthesis — East Asian eye geometry refined by Eastern European angularity, Sub-Saharan warmth and generous facial structure blended with South Asian complexion saturation and cheekbone architecture, North African solar tones creating a beautifully complex fusion that reads as distinctly 2226 GLMZ diaspora.
physical_description.build: Slight and wiry, all kinetic energy — no excess mass, shoulders narrow but defined from constant movement and manual labor. Built for speed and endurance rather than strength.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with deliberate platinum bleach at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Long, often pulled back with whatever's at hand (thread, wire, fabric scraps); appears intentionally unkempt, not neglected
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden and reddish undertones, sun-weathered from outdoor organizing work, reflecting the complex blend of East Asian, Sub-Saharan African, South Asian, Eastern European, and North African ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones dominate a narrow face with medium width showing interplay of East Asian refinement and Sub-Saharan African structural generosity. Eyes set with East Asian geometry refined by Eastern European intensity. Skin deep and warm-toned, sun-weathered, mobile expression rarely still. Facial features show striking harmony of Eastern European angularity with broader Sub-Saharan African structure, South Asian warmth and brow definition, and East Asian eye-set.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent gold freckles across nose and cheekbones in scattered constellation pattern — glow faintly in low light, mod calibrated for aesthetic rather than utility
Pale scar on left forearm (2cm, thin) from fence wire during Burnside Pocket demolition site access at age 15
Calluses on palms and fingers from handling signage, rope, and climbing infrastructure
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent freckles are the only immediately visible mod. Voice amplification implant in throat is invisible at rest but produces faint subsonic hum when powered; occasionally visible feedback distortion during high-volume speech.
physical_description.posture_movement: Never fully still — fidgets with objects (tape, fabric, phone) while listening. Walks with deliberate efficiency, eyes scanning surroundings. Stands with weight forward, ready to move. Speaks with hands, whole body engaged in communication. When focused on a crowd, her stillness is almost predatory.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 5 aesthetic — layered secondhand synthetics in muted colors (grays, blacks, olive), patches visible and intentional. Worn boots, reinforced at heel. Always wearing a homemade red armband on left bicep constructed from transit stripe tape — frayed at edges, faded from daily wear but fastidiously maintained as symbol. No jewelry except a threadbare cord bracelet. Practical, cheap, built for movement and durability over appearance.
